notes: expected_number values computed from v_brighton_* after migrate_semantic_layer.sql (2026-08-31).
Ari is the regression case: official=15, all-tracked-including-friendly=16.

regression_pair.season_sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS shots FROM v_brighton_shots_official WHERE is_brighton_shot AND player_name = 'Ari'
regression_pair.overall_sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS shots FROM v_brighton_shots_official WHERE is_brighton_shot AND player_name = 'Ari'

cases.question: How many total shots does Ari have this season?
cases.truth_sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS shots FROM v_brighton_shots_official WHERE is_brighton_shot AND player_name = 'Ari'

cases.question: How many total shots does Ari have overall?
cases.truth_sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS shots FROM v_brighton_shots_official WHERE is_brighton_shot AND player_name = 'Ari'

cases.question: How many shots did we take against Viewmont?
cases.truth_sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS shots FROM v_brighton_shots_official WHERE is_brighton_shot AND opponent_name = 'Viewmont'

cases.question: Who has the most shots on target this season?
cases.truth_sql: SELECT player_name, count(*)::int AS shots FROM v_brighton_shots_official WHERE is_brighton_shot AND is_on_frame GROUP BY player_name ORDER BY shots DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which players scored the most goals this season?
cases.truth_sql: SELECT player_name, count(*)::int AS goals FROM v_brighton_shots_official WHERE is_brighton_shot AND is_goal GROUP BY player_name ORDER BY goals DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many Brighton goals this season?
cases.truth_sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS goals FROM v_brighton_shots_official WHERE is_brighton_shot AND is_goal

cases.question: How many total Brighton shots this season?
cases.truth_sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS shots FROM v_brighton_shots_official WHERE is_brighton_shot

cases.question: What has changed about our attacking performance over the last four games?
cases.truth_sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM (SELECT 1 FROM v_brighton_games WHERE stat_scope IN ('official','preseason') ORDER BY game_date DESC LIMIT 4) t

cases.question: How many of our scheduled official or preseason games are not yet tracked?
cases.truth_sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM v_brighton_games WHERE stat_scope IN ('official','preseason') AND is_tracked = false

cases.question: Including friendlies, how many total Brighton shots are in the tracker?
cases.truth_sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS shots FROM v_brighton_shots WHERE is_brighton_shot

cases.question: How many Brighton shots came from friendlies?
cases.truth_sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS shots FROM v_brighton_shots WHERE is_brighton_shot AND stat_scope = 'friendly'

cases.question: How many shots on frame have we taken this season?
cases.truth_sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS shots FROM v_brighton_shots_official WHERE is_brighton_shot AND is_on_frame
